task: T13 research: probability calibration + position sizing beyond T+delta gating

schemes.A: Temperature scaling (Guo 2017) — 1-param softmax rescale, preserves argmax; expected LOSO +1~+5
schemes.B: Beta calibration (Kull 2017) per-class — 3-param logistic on (log(s), log(1-s)); +1~+4
schemes.C: Isotonic OvR — non-parametric monotone fit; +0~+3 with mild overfit risk
schemes.D: LdP z-score gating — m=side*(2*Phi(z)-1) with z=(p_top - 1/K)/sqrt(p(1-p)); +2~+6, NO RETRAIN
schemes.E: Bayes EV with cost matrix — argmax over EV[a]=R[a,y]*p_y; +3~+8
schemes.F: Meta-labeling (LdP) — secondary classifier on M1-profitability; +5~+12 (highest potential)
schemes.G: Conformal prediction sets (Mondrian) — distribution-free abstain rule; +1~+5
schemes.H: Multi-horizon agreement gating — trade only if h_5/10/20 agree; +2~+7
schemes.I: Vol-regime adaptive threshold — sigma_window scales T; +0~+3
schemes.J: Distributional regression head (NGBoost / quantile-LGBM) — direct P(Delta_mid > +alpha); +2~+8

top_2_recommendations.1: Scheme D (LdP z-score gating) — 1-day, no retrain, no risk; replaces (T, delta) with threshold_m
top_2_recommendations.2: Scheme E (Bayes EV decision rule) — 0.5-2 day depending on whether we add regression head; principled, fee-aware

notes: Current T=0.55, delta=0.10 is empirically near Kelly-optimal hit rate given fee/avg_move ratio ~1.25. Further gains must come from (a) calibrating p so threshold has true meaning, or (b) replacing argmax-based rule with EV-based rule. Combining Scheme A (calibration) + Scheme D or E (decision rule) is the recommended fast path.
